headings.style: Elegant, editorial, high-contrast serif. Use tracking-tight for large text.
headings.weights: Light (300) or Regular (400) for elegance. Bold (700) sparingly.

body.weights: Regular (400) for body, Medium (500) for UI labels.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use subtle ambient shadows like shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] for elevated elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid delicate borders (border-[#E5E5E0]) to define cards without heavy contrast.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F9F6]/80 for sticky headers and bottom mobile bars.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle rounding. Use rounded-lg (8px) or rounded-xl (12px). Avoid excessive pill shapes except for primary CTA buttons.

layouts.spacing: Generous white space. Use py-24 or py-32 for section spacing on desktop. Padding p-8 or p-12 inside major cards.
layouts.grids: Bento-style grids for category highlights (e.g., col-span-2 row-span-2 for hero category). 3-to-4 column responsive grids for menu items.
layouts.containers: Max-width 7xl (max-w-7xl) for main content to maintain editorial proportions.

motion.hover_states: Images inside cards scale up slightly (scale-105) on hover with overflow-hidden on parent. Buttons have smooth background color transitions.
motion.entrance: Fade up (translate-y-4 to translate-y-0 with opacity 0 to 1) for menu sections as they scroll into view.
motion.page_transitions: Smooth and fast. Do not over-animate e-commerce flows (Cart/Checkout) to prevent friction.

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky top glassmorphism header. Must include Logo, Links, and a prominent Cart icon with a badge for item count. Desktop: Full links. Mobile: Hamburger opening a clean full-screen menu.
components_strategy.product_card: Editorial presentation. Large square image, minimalist typography underneath. Title (serif), Price (sans-serif, bold). An elegant 'Add to Cart' button that is either always visible (mobile) or fades in on hover (desktop).
components_strategy.cart: Persistent Slide-out Drawer (Sheet component from Shadcn). Show items, subtotal, delivery calculation placeholder, and a clear checkout button.
components_strategy.checkout: Progressive, step-based flow. Very clean, high-trust design with Stripe integration.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn inputs. Floating labels or very clean labels above inputs. No default browser focus rings; use focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#C84B31] focus:border-[#C84B31].

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the #F9F9F6 background meets at least AA standards.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus states on all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like the Cart or Favorites).

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply fonts in tailwind.config.js: fontFamily: { serif: ['Cormorant Garamond', 'serif'], sans: ['Manrope', 'sans-serif'] }
Ensure all Shadcn components (Cards, Buttons, Inputs, Dialogs) are customized to match the Bone White and Terracotta palette, overriding default slate/zinc borders and backgrounds.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements for testing (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').
Build a robust e-commerce flow: React Context or Redux for Cart State, allowing Guest and Authenticated checkout.
Implement JWT + Google OAuth for user authentication.
Integrate a visually elegant delivery cost calculator in the checkout flow.
Avoid cringe or overly generic vector illustrations. Use the provided high-end photography.
Ensure image tags use object-cover and aspect-square or aspect-[4/5] for product photos.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep the UI very clean.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and panels.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles, specifically for this app: sharp or slightly rounded corners with terracotta backgrounds and smooth hover transitions.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
